COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
I.A. No.2 of 2025 (Money Withdrawal Appl.)
In
A.O. No.96 of 2025
Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Shankar Aggarwal, Advocate, holding
brief of Mr. Naresh Pant, Advocate for the
appellant.
Mr. Chandramauli Shah, Advocate for
respondent no.1.
Mr. B.S. Koranga, Advocate for
respondent no.3.
2. This money withdrawal application has
been filed by claimant for withdrawal of the
amount of compensation deposited by the
Insurance Company before learned Tribunal.
3. Learned Tribunal had awarded a sum of
₹2,30,801/- as compensation to the claimant.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that
the appellant has deposited the entire awarded
amount with the concerned tribunal, in terms of
the order passed by this Court.
4. Having regard to the facts and
circumstances of the case, money withdrawal
application is allowed. Learned Tribunal is
directed to release 50% of the awarded amount
in favour of claimant, without asking any
security. The remaining amount shall be
invested in an interest bearing scheme of a
nationalized bank.
5. Learned counsel is permitted to take fresh
steps in order to serve respondent no.2 who, as
per office report, is unserved.
6. List alongwith A.O. No.116 of 2022.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 11.09.2025
Arpan
